title: Expand secondary insect research and ant size polymorphism data
objective: Expand the existing secondary-insect evidence pack with hundreds of megabytes of open empirical data where possible, deepen species comparisons, and add evidence-backed ant worker size/caste variation without changing verified runtime code.
acceptance_criteria: Research branch continues from the existing secondary-insect research lineage rather than restarting
Raw/open datasets are fetched with source URLs, byte counts and cryptographic hashes when redistribution permits
The expanded pack clearly distinguishes mirrored empirical bytes from derived/synthetic fixtures and remote-only indexes
Ant worker size variation uses empirical within-species/caste/allometry evidence instead of arbitrary uniform scaling
No verified application/runtime code is modified during this research expansion
Implementation plan is updated with size-dependent ant morphology and locomotion requirements
